newsitem.title: USA: 3-D Geophysical to offer 3.5 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: 3-D Geophysical to offer 3.5 mln shrs.

text.p: 3-D Geophysical Inc announced a public offering of 3.5 million shares of common stock at $7.50 per share with anticipated net proceeds of $23.9 million.
The company said it had initially proposed to offer 4.3 million shares.

The company said the net proceeds will be used to buy additional seismic data acquisition systems and related vehicles and equipment (approximately $16.9 million) and to fund a portion of the purchase price for a Canadian seismic exploration business, J.R.S. Exploration Co Ltd.

The proceeds will also be used to repay debts incurred in connection with the company's purchase in May 1996 of two 24-bit seismic data acquisition systems ($3.0 million), and the balance, if any, will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes.
